notes.subject: Territory hold / Kristy 2026 call notes
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes for Oregon BBQ & Brews say she called Richard, 2026 was missed, information was sent for 2027, and Adventure Zone was considered too expensive. The sheet notes the present bounce-house company charges roughly $2,000-$3,000. Preserve as relationship/pricing context only. Oregon territory hold — do not create normal active outreach follow-up. Source: handwritten call notes, page 79.
